Documentation / Project

Agent operating manual

Operating manual for AI coding agents and new contributors working in this repository. README.md provides orientation for human readers; this file defines the rules and procedures. Where a nested AGENTS.md or an explicit user instruction conflicts with this file, the more specific instruction takes precedence.

Project

The repository is Vodka Stack, a monorepo containing Vodka, a native macOS application that runs Steam and Windows games on Apple Silicon (a fork of Whisky via frankea's community fork); OpenV, an open-source ScriptHookV replacement for GTA V Enhanced; and the local Wine/CrossOver build workbench shared by both. Toolchain: Swift 6, SwiftUI, macOS 15 or later, Xcode 16 or later.

Repository map

Path Role Notes
apps/vodka/Vodka/ SwiftUI application target New files require entries in Vodka.xcodeproj.
apps/vodka/VodkaKit/ Swift package containing the logic: Wine, bottles, Steam, library, playtime SwiftPM discovers new files automatically. Tests reside here.
apps/vodka/VodkaCmd/ Command-line interface used by Dock shortcuts to launch games
apps/vodka/VodkaThumbnail/ Quick Look thumbnail extension for .exe files
apps/vodka/VodkaUITests/ XCUITest suite for the application Fixture-dependent tests skip when no bottle exists.
apps/vodka/scripts/ Build, release, localization and secret-scan helpers
apps/vodka/docs/ Dependency, release and troubleshooting documentation Runtime pins must match apps/vodka/docs/DEPENDENCIES.md.
apps/openv/ GTA V Enhanced map tooling (Python, C and Swift probes) See apps/openv/PLAN.md.
engine/winecx/, engine/dxmt-work/dxmt/ Patched Wine and DXMT sources, tracked as subtrees Build outputs and toolchains inside them remain untracked.
engine/ (remainder) Untracked runtime lanes, packages and caches Read engine/README.md before modifying anything.
.build/ Root DerivedData and SwiftPM output for the workspace Never commit. apps/vodka/VodkaKit/.build is ignored separately.

engine/ must remain at the workspace root because Vodka's scripts resolve ../../engine. apps/vodka must not be moved relative to it.

Environment

  • Apple Silicon Mac, macOS 15 or later, Xcode 16 or later (swift --version should report Swift 6).
  • swiftlint, which runs automatically as an Xcode build phase; violations fail the build.
  • swiftformat 0.58.7, the version CI downloads. Homebrew's swiftformat is usually newer than that pin; verify swiftformat --version and install the 0.58.7 release if --lint reports differences that CI does not.
  • trufflehog for apps/vodka/scripts/scan-secrets.sh (brew install trufflehog).
  • OpenV: Python 3.9 or later, with capstone installed in apps/openv/.venv. The rebuild command creates the environment.
  • Engine work: Wine/CrossOver checkouts and mingw-w64. See engine/README.md.

Commands

Run commands from the repository root unless a cd is shown.

Vodka: build, test, install

# Build the application (Debug, unsigned, with the codesign flags CI uses)
xcodebuild -project apps/vodka/Vodka.xcodeproj -scheme Vodka -configuration Debug build \
  -derivedDataPath .build/debug \
  CODE_SIGN_IDENTITY="" CODE_SIGNING_REQUIRED=NO CODE_SIGNING_ALLOWED=NO

# Build every scheme, as CI does
for scheme in Vodka VodkaCmd VodkaThumbnail; do
  xcodebuild -project apps/vodka/Vodka.xcodeproj -scheme "$scheme" -configuration Debug build \
    CODE_SIGN_IDENTITY="" CODE_SIGNING_REQUIRED=NO CODE_SIGNING_ALLOWED=NO
done

# Release build, ad-hoc signed, installed to /Applications
apps/vodka/scripts/install-local.sh

# Unit tests (VodkaKit); fast, run for any logic change
swift test --package-path apps/vodka/VodkaKit

# A single suite or test
swift test --package-path apps/vodka/VodkaKit --filter CommandKeyMappingTests

# UI tests (slow; run only when UI behaviour changed)
xcodebuild -project apps/vodka/Vodka.xcodeproj -scheme Vodka -configuration Debug \
  -destination 'platform=macOS' -only-testing:VodkaUITests test \
  CODE_SIGN_IDENTITY="" CODE_SIGNING_REQUIRED=NO CODE_SIGNING_ALLOWED=NO

Vodka: style, strings, secrets

cd apps/vodka
swiftformat --lint .                     # check; fix with: swiftformat .
swiftlint --strict                      # configuration: .swiftlint.yml
./scripts/british-english.py --check    # en-GB must cover every en key
./scripts/scan-secrets.sh               # same check as CI (TruffleHog)

Vodka: Direct3D 12 layer

apps/vodka/scripts/build-vodka-d3d12.sh

Requires engine/dxmt-work/dxmt (or an explicit checkout path) with its toolchains/ directory present. Stages DLLs into apps/vodka/build/vodka-d3d12/.

OpenV

apps/openv/Rebuild\ OpenV\ Map.command     # opens GTA V, dumps, rebuilds the map (~20 min)

# Pipeline stages directly (dump, live-table TSV, build, output)
apps/openv/.venv/bin/python apps/openv/research/rebuild.py \
  <dump.bin> <natives.tsv> <build> <out.txt>

The rebuild command requires GTA V Enhanced to be installed in a Vodka bottle. It is interactive and slow, so it must not be used as an automated check.

Engine

cd engine && ruby local-build.rb            # replays the runtime-up CI build locally

This requires the untracked engine/runtime-up checkout described in engine/README.md; it does not exist in a fresh clone. The other untracked lanes (runtime-47, runtime-ci, pkg-*) are independent nested git repositories; their contents must never be committed from the workspace repository. The two tracked subtrees, engine/winecx and engine/dxmt-work/dxmt, are committed here.

Delete build/, staging/ and smoke-prefix* when finished. They occupy several gigabytes and can be rebuilt.

Architecture and boundaries

  • Layering. UI and application lifecycle code belongs in apps/vodka/Vodka/; Wine, bottle, Steam, library and playtime logic belongs in VodkaKit. Testable logic belongs in VodkaKit, not in views.
  • Game fixes are data. A fix that only changes Windows settings for one game belongs in VodkaKit/Sources/VodkaKit/GameDatabase/Resources/GameDB.json, with a reference to the origin of the fix. Games must not be special-cased in Swift.
  • Runtime is downloaded, not vendored. The application fetches Libraries.tar.gz according to VodkaKit/Sources/VodkaKit/Utils/DistributionConfig.swift. Runtime binaries must never be added to the repository. Runtime pins live in apps/vodka/.github/workflows/RuntimeTrack.yml and must remain in sync with apps/vodka/docs/DEPENDENCIES.md.
  • Localization. New user-facing strings are added to apps/vodka/Vodka/Localizable.xcstrings in English only, edited as text with only the required lines touched. Re-saving the file with a JSON tool reorders the catalog. Run apps/vodka/scripts/british-english.py afterwards to regenerate en-GB.
  • Xcode project. Files added to the application target (Vodka/) require Vodka.xcodeproj entries, while VodkaKit discovers files automatically. Adding those entries for a new source file is expected and is the only project.pbxproj edit permitted (see hard rule 3).
  • Generated site. apps/vodka/dist/pages/ is published output (appcast, index). Modify it through scripts/publish-update.sh or scripts/build-og-card.sh, never by hand.
  • OpenV safety contract. Single-player only; GTA Online and BattlEye are hard-refused; no anti-cheat bypass; no game asset or code redistribution; the MSVC-mangled ABI must remain drop-in compatible (see apps/openv/PLAN.md). These are product requirements, not preferences.

Code conventions

  • Every Swift file begins with the GPL header ("This file is part of Vodka, a fork of Whisky."). file_header is an error-level SwiftLint rule; copy the header from an existing file.
  • SwiftFormat configuration: 4-space indent, maximum width 120, --guardelse next-line, alphabetical import grouping, no semicolons. redundantSelf is disabled, so explicit self is preserved; do not remove it by hand. Run the formatter rather than matching style manually.
  • SwiftLint enables force_unwrapping; do not add ! unwraps in new code.
  • Prefer existing patterns (bottle abstractions, the Bottle and Wine types, swift-testing suites for new tests) over new abstractions or dependencies. Ask before adding a package.
  • VodkaKit tests are mixed: XCTest and swift-testing (@Test, struct ...Tests) coexist. New tests use swift-testing, and existing XCTest files are not ported as incidental churn. VodkaUITests uses XCTest throughout.
  • Changelog: describe user-facing changes under [Unreleased] in apps/vodka/CHANGELOG.md.
  • Commit messages are imperative and scoped, for example vodka: fix Steam launch resolver, openv: verify entity list bounds, docs: update the README, engine: bump DXMT.

Writing and communication

One register applies to all text produced in this repository or in conversation with the maintainer, unless an explicit instruction states otherwise. Do not require the user to ask for it.

Scope. The policy covers:

  • documentation, README files, plans, ADRs and design notes;
  • pull request titles, descriptions, review comments and issue replies;
  • commit messages and code comments;
  • every response to the maintainer, including short status updates, questions and summaries of work.

Register.

  • Use complete sentences and state the fact or the action directly.
  • Do not use contractions, em-dash asides, exclamation marks or decorative emoji.
  • Do not use marketing superlatives, and do not assert claims the repository cannot substantiate. Quantify only values that were measured.
  • Use the imperative mood for instructions, the present tense for descriptions, and "must" or "do not" for requirements.
  • Use one term per concept and do not alternate synonyms for the same object.
  • Prefer the concrete path, command or symbol to a paraphrase of it.

Exceptions. A guide written for non-specialists (for example apps/openv/HOW TO FIX MODS AFTER A GTA UPDATE.txt) may use plain language while keeping the same structure and avoiding slang. An explicit user instruction to write briefly or informally overrides this section for that response only.

Testing guidance

  • Logic change: swift test --package-path apps/vodka/VodkaKit, with --filter for the affected suite.
  • Application or UI change: build the affected scheme; run VodkaUITests only when the interaction itself changed.
  • Strings or localization: apps/vodka/scripts/british-english.py --check.
  • Formatting and lint: swiftformat --lint . and swiftlint --strict.
  • CI-only checks (coverage upload, Codecov, gh-pages) may be skipped locally.
  • Never weaken, skip or delete a test to obtain a passing run. Fix the cause and report anything that could not be run.

Git workflow

  • Every change goes through a pull request by default. This applies to all work, including code, documentation, configuration and one-line fixes. Do not wait for the user to request a pull request or to point out that one is needed: branch, push the branch, open the pull request and report its URL as part of completing the task.

  • Never push to main directly. Do not git push to main, do not push a branch that is then fast-forwarded into main by hand, and do not merge a pull request without explicit user approval. The standard procedure:

    git switch -c vodka/short-description
# edit, then run the checks in the table below
git add <explicit paths>
git commit -m "vodka: fix Steam launch resolver"
git push -u origin vodka/short-description
gh pr create --fill --base main

    main currently has no required status checks, so GitHub will not block a failing pull request. Run the checks yourself rather than treating a green merge button as evidence.

  • Delete the branch after every pull request. Once the pull request merges, remove the remote branch with git push origin --delete <branch> and the local branch with git branch -d <branch>, then run git fetch --prune to drop stale remote-tracking references. A pull request that is closed without merging is cleaned up the same way.

  • One repository serves the whole workspace, published as rolling7ho/vodka-stack (origin, branch main). The histories of apps/vodka, apps/openv, engine/winecx and engine/dxmt-work/dxmt were imported with git subtree; their full graphs are present and the latter two repositories are archived read-only.

  • When syncing Vodka upstream, add the remotes first if they are missing:

    git remote add vodka    https://github.com/rolling7ho/vodka-stack.git   # if missing
git remote add upstream https://github.com/frankea/Whisky.git      # if missing
git fetch vodka --no-tags
git subtree pull --prefix apps/vodka vodka vodka-d3d12 --squash

  • Stage explicit paths. Never use git add -A in a workspace containing untracked local trees, and never run git clean -xdf at the root, which deletes the contents of engine/.

  • The engine runtime lanes keep their own nested repositories, which workspace git operations must not rewrite. engine/winecx and engine/dxmt-work/dxmt are subtrees of this repository.

Hard rules

  1. Do not move apps/vodka or engine relative to the workspace root. Scripts and Xcode paths depend on the current layout.
  2. Do not commit engine lane outputs (engine/runtime-*, engine/pkg-*, engine/deps, build caches), .build/, *.tar.gz, packaged runtimes, logs or machine-specific artifacts. Only engine/README.md, engine/winecx/ and engine/dxmt-work/dxmt/ are tracked; the root .gitignore encodes this.
  3. Do not edit generated files by hand: apps/vodka/dist/pages/, the formatting of Vodka/Localizable.xcstrings, or *.xcodeproj internals. The one permitted Vodka.xcodeproj edit is adding the file references and build-phase entries that a new application-target source file requires.
  4. Do not introduce secrets, API keys, certificates or provisioning profiles. The Sparkle signing key resides in the maintainer's keychain (vodka account) and must never be placed in the repository.
  5. The engine lanes (engine/runtime-47, runtime-up, runtime-ci and their own winecx checkouts) keep separate git histories. Do not rewrite them from the workspace repository. engine/winecx and engine/dxmt-work/dxmt are subtrees, so changes to them are committed here.
  6. Do not enable GTA Online, anti-cheat bypasses or game asset redistribution in OpenV, and keep its exports ABI-compatible.
  7. Do not run destructive commands (git reset --hard, git clean -xdf, rm -rf engine/...) unless the user explicitly requests that exact action.
  8. Do not add a dependency or a new top-level directory without asking.
  9. Do not push to main, and do not consider a change complete until it is on a branch with an open pull request. This is the default for every change, including documentation and trivial fixes, and requires no prompt. Only the merge into main waits for the user to ask.
  10. Write in the formal technical register defined under Writing and communication. The policy applies to every document, plan, ADR, pull request comment and reply to the maintainer, and requires no reminder from the user.

Verification before finishing

You changed Run at least
VodkaKit logic swift test --package-path apps/vodka/VodkaKit --filter <suite>
Application or UI build the Vodka scheme; VodkaUITests if interaction changed
User-facing strings cd apps/vodka && ./scripts/british-english.py --check
Swift style cd apps/vodka && swiftformat --lint . && swiftlint --strict
Documentation only check links and paths; builds may be skipped
Engine cd engine && ruby local-build.rb (or the lane's workflow)
OpenV run the affected script against a real dump; the map rebuild is manual

Report exactly which checks ran, their result, and any check that could not be run. Compiling is not equivalent to testing behaviour.

Known pitfalls

  • SwiftLint is skipped silently in Xcode when CI=true is set, so a local build can pass while CI fails. Run swiftlint --strict explicitly.
  • en-GB must be complete. A single missing string causes macOS to display the raw key to British users. Regenerate it after modifying apps/vodka/Vodka/Localizable.xcstrings.
  • The application bundle must ship winetricks, verbs.txt and cabextract. CI asserts on the built artifact because the copy phase can omit them without failing.
  • CI workflows reside in apps/vodka/.github, inherited from the application repository, so GitHub does not run them from the monorepo root. Do not assume those workflows are active.
  • The untracked engine trees are machine-specific. Build logs and generated CMake files under engine/dxmt-work/dxmt/toolchains/ embed absolute /Users/ivan/Desktop/vodka/... paths. Do not copy commands or paths from them, and never commit them.
